title: Preparation of dsRNA viruses for next-generation sequencing
author: Alexander H Wilcox
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ugnetve
materials: RNA should be extracted using a commercially available kit. We used an RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen). Kits that require carrier RNA are not recommended because this will interfere with sequencing.

steps.title: Filter and Nuclease Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove host debris and degrade extracapsular nucleic acids from viral lysates.

substeps.instruction: Pass viral lysates through a 0.22μm filter.
Add 25μl DNAse I, 50μl RNAse A/T1, and 1X DNAse I Buffer to 1ml of filtrate.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the RNA using Qubit, noting that low viral titres or small genomes may fall below the limit of detection.

steps.title: RNA Denaturation and Purification
steps.instruction: Denature the RNA and purify the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 50% DMSO to the RNA sample.
Purify RNA using a column cleanup kit (e.g., Qiagen RNeasy MinElute Cleanup Kit), ethanol precipitation, or TRIzol purification.

steps.title: First Strand Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize the first strand of cDNA from the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 5μl purified RNA to 1μl random hexamers, 1μl dNTPs, and 3μl nuclease-free water.
Add 0.01M DTT, 5mM MgCl2, 1X reverse transcriptase buffer, 1μl RNAseOUT, and 1μl Superscript III enzyme to each reaction.
Bring reactions to a total volume of 20μl using nuclease-free water.
Incubate in a thermal cycler for 10 minutes at 25ºC, 50 minutes at 50ºC, and 5 minutes at 85ºC.

steps.title: Second Strand Synthesis and Purification
steps.instruction: Synthesize the second strand of DNA and purify the resulting double-stranded DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1μl dNTPs, 0.5μl DNA ligase, 2μl DNA polymerase I, 0.5μl RNAse H, and 1X second strand synthesis buffer.
Bring the total volume to 40μl using nuclease-free water.
Purify DNA using a preferred method (e.g., Macharey-Nagal Nucleospin Gel and PCR Clean-up kit).

steps.title: Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare DNA libraries for sequencing using a chosen platform and library preparation kit (e.g., Nextera XT).
